chunks: But when they were given a healthy son, they started ascribing to other powers a share in what God had bestowed on them. But God is above what they ascribe to Him.
ai.seo_question: What is the origin of shirk according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights how material prosperity, particularly the gift of offspring, often leads to spiritual complacency and the attribution of divine power to created beings or natural forces. It serves as a critique of the polytheistic mindset where gratitude is diluted by associating partners with Allah, emphasizing His absolute transcendence (Tanzih) from such imperfections.
